New leaves at last on the old maple
Mud everywhere on the lane
Ice gone from the pond

This autumn we painted leaves.
Then we baked bread.
Next we will carve pumpkins.
The market sells boxes of 6, 13, 20 or 27 apples and bags of 3 or 10 pears.

The book fair is in the hall all week.
Science week follows right after it.

Storm cleanup took 19 hours
The freeze lasted 12 nights
The walk was 5 miles

short: day number in a date series
notes: Single dates scored near zero in probes; the pole needs a series. A plain number list with the same weekly spacing scored 0.21, so part of the signal may be the arithmetic series rather than the dates.
